newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Post Ministry ordered to check Omnitel cover.
newsitem.headline: Italy Post Ministry ordered to check Omnitel cover.

text.p: The Italian state council has ordered the Posts and Telecommunications Ministry to make a further check on the level of national territory coverage of mobile phone service operator Omnitel, council sources said.

The State Council, the country's highest court for administrative justice, allowed an appeal by the first mobile phone licence holder Telecom Italia Mobile (TIM) which is state controlled, against a regional court ruling concerning Omnitel's national coverage.
Omnitel, which is controlled by an international consortium led by information technology group Olivetti, is Italy's second GSM licence holder.

A regional court in the province of Lazio late last year rejected an appeal by TIM against Omnitel, in which TIM alleged the other group had failed to reach 40 percent coverage which was a prerequisite for being granted a roaming concession.
